project.name: Career Mantra OS
project.summary: Operating system for job search in India with automation, privacy-first controls, and human-in-the-loop governance.

decisions.summary: Human approval is required before job applications are submitted.
decisions.rationale: Automation should reduce effort without removing user control.

decisions.summary: Cloud AI is optional; local inference should remain available.
decisions.rationale: Privacy-sensitive job-search data should stay local by default when possible.

decisions.summary: Submission proof artifacts must be captured for all automated application flows.
decisions.rationale: Users need verification that automation executed correctly.

tasks.title: Define project notebook and benchmark baseline
tasks.notes: Map the product, benchmark pack, and initial dependencies.

tasks.title: Build job discovery and deduplication MVP
tasks.notes: At least Naukri, LinkedIn, and Indeed should be supported in MVP.

tasks.title: Implement human approval gate for auto-apply flow
tasks.notes: User must review and approve before submission.

tasks.title: Implement privacy-first local/cloud execution policy
tasks.notes: Cloud must be opt-in and local path must be real.
